name: 蹦蹦花
evolution: 蹦蹦种子 → 蹦蹦草 Lv.16 → 蹦蹦花 Lv.32 → 蹦蹦果
evolutionEn: Bengbengzhongzi → Bengbengcao Lv.16 → Bengbenghua Lv.32 → Bengbengguo
description: 休息的时候会把脚插入地下一动不动，但似乎随时能够进入战斗状态。头上的花不允许任何人触碰，那似乎是它生命力量的来源。
descriptionEn: When resting it buries its feet in the ground and stays perfectly still, yet it seems ready to enter battle at any moment. The flower on its head must not be touched by anyone; it appears to be the source of its life force.

skills.name: 汲取
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage and drains 100% of the damage as HP.

skills.name: 根吸收
skills.descriptionEn: Restores 15% HP and 4 energy to itself.

skills.name: 毒沼
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 毒孢子
skills.descriptionEn: Inflicts 5 stacks of poison on the enemy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%. Counters attacks.

skills.name: 孢子
skills.descriptionEn: Inflicts 1 stack of parasitism on the enemy.

skills.name: 蜡质膜
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：回复3能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 80%. Counters attacks: restores 3 energy.

skills.name: 叶绿光束
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 针刺射击
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，自己回复7点能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. If the opponent switches creature this turn, restores 7 energy to itself.

skills.name: 腐化
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，敌方获得双攻-30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each stack of poison on the enemy, the enemy loses 30% of both attacks.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. For each stack of poison on the enemy, this skill's energy cost -1, and inflicts 1 stack of poison on the enemy.

skills.name: 剧毒
skills.description: 敌方获得3层中毒，应对防御：改为获得8层。
skills.descriptionEn: Inflicts 3 stacks of poison on the enemy. Counters defense: instead inflicts 8 stacks.

skills.name: 仙人掌刺击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 芳香诱引
skills.description: 自己获得连击数+2，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains +2 combo count. Counters defense: additionally interrupts, and the enemy becomes stunned next turn.

skills.name: 落井下毒
skills.description: 使敌方精灵减益的层数翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Doubles the number of debuff stacks on the enemy creature.
